faqs.question: Why take Histopathology-Cervix Biopsy?
faqs.answer: To evaluate cervical cancer in women.

faqs.question: More Info on Histopathology-Cervix Biopsy
faqs.answer: Detects cervical cancer in women. A cervical biopsy is a procedure to remove tissue from the cervix to test for abnormal or precancerous conditions, or cervical cancer.
